recipes.name: One-Pot Creamy Mushroom Fusilli
instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil over high heat. Add the shallots, garlic, and chili and sauté for about 3 minutes, until lightly golden.
Add the remaining ingredients (except for the spinach).
Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to a gentle simmer, partially cover, and cook, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, for about 15 minutes, or until the pasta is al dente.
Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted. Taste and add more salt and pepper if you like.
If desired, finish with a sprinkle of basil*. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Optionally, you can swap the vegetable broth for 2½ bouillon cubes dissolved in 2½ cups (600 ml) of water. If doing so, omit the added salt. † One (13.5 oz / 400ml) can yields about 1⅔ cups. * A squeeze of lemon juice is also a lovely addition.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
